project.title: Standardised SME Tax Compliance Review Program
project.objective: Design and pilot a standardised process to review SME client tax files, detect issues early, and ensure timely, compliant tax return preparation.
deliverables: Documented end-to-end SME tax file review workflow
Standardised tax review checklist and risk flags catalogue
Template spreadsheet for tax calculations and reconciliations
Guideline on fraud indicators and escalation steps
Pilot review results report with remediation actions
Training brief for new tax clerks on the new process
constraints: All materials must comply with current tax legislation and bookkeeping regulations
Initial pilot must cover at least 30 SME client files within the timebox
Use only approved spreadsheet software and existing document templates
No direct changes to official accounting systems, only documented adjustments
Client-identifying data must be anonymised in shared artifacts
Process must be simple enough to execute within standard monthly workload

risks.risk: Misinterpretation of tax legislation leading to incorrect review rules.
risks.mitigation: Have compliance officer validate checklist and guidelines before pilot.

risks.risk: Workload peaks delay completion of the 30-file pilot sample.
risks.mitigation: Prioritise lower-complexity files and timebox reviews; adjust sample mix if needed.

risks.risk: Inconsistent use of the checklist by different tax clerks.
risks.mitigation: Run a short alignment session and use sample reviewed files as reference examples.

risks.risk: Fraud indicators identified but not escalated properly.
risks.mitigation: Define clear escalation thresholds and a simple incident ticket template.
Peer-review formulas on a test set of files before wider rollout.

themes.why_relevant: Ensures the new review process and checklists are fully compliant and up to date.
Reduces variation between tax clerks and improves auditability of reviews.
Clarifies how to flag suspicious patterns and when to involve compliance or auditors.
Accurate templates and records are critical for reliable calculations and audits.
Balancing the pilot work with regular tax return deadlines avoids bottlenecks.

backlog.task: Map current SME tax file review steps and identify common pain points
definition_of_done: Current-state workflow drafted with 6–10 key steps
List of at least 8 recurring issues or bottlenecks documented
Validated by at least two tax clerks via comments or sign-off

backlog.task: Draft standardised SME tax review checklist including risk flags
definition_of_done: Checklist covers bookkeeping, tax calculation, and documentation checks
At least 10 risk flags defined with short descriptions
Reviewed once against tax legislation summary for consistency

backlog.task: Create spreadsheet template for SME tax calculations and reconciliations
definition_of_done: Template includes input, calculation, and summary tabs
Key formulas tested on 3 anonymised sample files
Peer review completed and issues, if any, fixed

backlog.task: Document fraud indicators and escalation procedure for suspicious cases
definition_of_done: List of at least 12 fraud indicators compiled
Escalation steps defined with thresholds and contacts by role
Compliance officer feedback captured and incorporated

backlog.task: Define anonymisation rules for client data in project artifacts
definition_of_done: Clear rules for masking names, IDs, and sensitive fields documented
Two sample files anonymised following the rules
No direct identifiers remain in shared examples

backlog.task: Select and register 30 SME client files for the pilot review
definition_of_done: List of 30 anonymised client file IDs created
Mix of industries and sizes documented
Availability of source documents confirmed

backlog.task: Run pilot reviews on selected SME files using new checklist and template
definition_of_done: At least 30 files reviewed with completed checklists
All calculations performed using the new spreadsheet template
Issues and anomalies logged for each file

backlog.task: Summarise pilot findings and propose process adjustments
definition_of_done: Summary of key findings and error patterns drafted
At least 5 concrete improvement suggestions listed
Shared with stakeholders for comments

backlog.task: Prepare short training brief for onboarding tax clerks to the new process
definition_of_done: Brief covers workflow, checklist, template, and escalation rules
Includes 2–3 practical examples from the pilot
Reviewed and approved by accounting manager role

backlog.task: Define simple quality control sampling for ongoing SME tax reviews
definition_of_done: Sampling rule documented (e.g., % of files per month)
QC checklist items defined and aligned with main checklist
Plan validated as feasible within current workload

backlog.task: Create incident log format for suspected fraud or major discrepancies
definition_of_done: Incident log template created with required fields
Test incident recorded using anonymised example
Template aligned with escalation guideline

backlog.task: Align with accounting manager on integration of new process into monthly cycle
definition_of_done: Touchpoints with monthly closing and tax filing identified
Agreed timeline for using the new process documented
Any conflicts with existing procedures noted and addressed

threads_plan.thread_goal: Align on current SME tax review workflow and main pain points.
threads_plan.trigger: Kickoff message asking everyone to describe how they currently review SME tax files.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Agree on a single current-state workflow version to document in A1.
Prioritise top 5 pain points to address in the new checklist and process.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Design and finalise the standard review checklist and spreadsheet template.
threads_plan.trigger: Post first draft of the checklist and spreadsheet asking for quick review and edits.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the first usable version of the SME tax review checklist (A2).
Lock the structure of the spreadsheet template (A3) for pilot use.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Define fraud indicators, escalation rules, and incident logging approach.
threads_plan.trigger: Message sharing initial fraud indicator list and asking for examples and thresholds.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Confirm the final list of fraud indicators and escalation steps in A4.
Agree on the incident log format and when to create an incident entry.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Plan and monitor the 30-file pilot execution and workload impact.
threads_plan.trigger: Post the draft pilot file register and ask for volunteers and timing confirmation.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Freeze the list of 30 pilot files in the register (A6).
Agree on a realistic schedule to complete all pilot reviews before the deadline.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Review pilot results and agree on adjustments and rollout approach.
threads_plan.trigger: Share the draft pilot findings report and ask for comments and final sign-off.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve key process changes based on pilot findings in A7.
Confirm the QC sampling approach and training brief content for rollout.

channel_rituals: Daily async check-in: each tax clerk posts what pilot files they will review and any blockers.
Twice-weekly checklist feedback thread: quick notes on confusing items or missing checks.
Weekly pilot status summary: one message summarising progress against the 30-file target.
Post-incident mini-review: short recap in channel after any fraud incident log is created.
